notes: «حدثنا أبي، ومحمد بن الحسن» are two co-transmitters of one level; «جميعا» closes the next level
«بإسناده يرفعه إلى» is a gap: the chain is linked up through unnamed narrators to Abu Jafar, and no names are filled in
«رضي الله عنهما» is an honorific and is left out; the Imam sits after «إلى» inside the chain, so he is a narrator
